name: Apple Music with Timbre
subtitle: Apple Music player and Timbre audio tools
description: Standalone MusicKit prototype for iPhone 17 on iOS 27. Apple Music authorization, library songs, search and playback. Timbre EQ applies to imported unprotected audio only; subscription EQ remains unavailable. Signing bundle ID needs MusicKit enabled. Device playback is unverified.
